players.product: Siyuan (MLU) cloud AI chips and accelerator cards, AI servers and intelligent computing cluster systems for large-model training and inference

quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: on April 24, 2026 it completed Day-0 adaptation of the new DeepSeek-V4 model on the vLLM inference framework through hardware-software co-optimization; its H1 2026 overall gross margin was 55.25% (55.15% in 2025), H1 revenue came mainly from the cloud product line, and it currently serves mainly domestic customers. It expects revenue to find new growth points and grow steadily over the next 3-5 years as its chips iterate, its software ecosystem matures and the business expands.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 gross margin 55.25% (2025: 55.15%); DeepSeek-V4 Day-0 adaptation on 04-24-2026
